sections.title: Tree and leaves
sections.text: Rhoiptelea chiliantha is a deciduous tree of southwestern China and northern Vietnam, reaching up to 20 m tall and 60 cm in trunk diameter. Its alternate pinnate leaves are about 15–40 cm long, with 7–13 leaflets.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: Long, drooping, branched inflorescences carry many small flowers. The fruit is a small, flattened nutlet with rounded wings about 5–8 mm wide.

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: Flora of China records its fine wood in building, furniture and utensils. The plate's compound leaves and long hanging clusters are consistent with the species.
